description: Shared preset of thomas-lg-lab (schedule, dashboard, security PRs, digests and SHAs pinned, three-day release age). Add this project's own managers, groups, ignores and auto-merge policy below.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor merge on their own once the required checks pass: merging only moves the edge image, a release stays a decision. Remove this rule to review every update by hand.

A digest-only update of a GitHub Action means its tag now points at another commit: the pattern of a hijacked tag (trivy-action, March 2026), which the release-age delay does not catch. Always reviewed by hand.
